modal.title: Handle Changes
modal.description:
Please note that any manual code changes will be lost if you continue with block coding. To keep your edits safe, we recommend saving them to a separate file first.

Do you want to continue with block coding?

mode_change.title: Mode Change Warning
mode_change.message: Changing the mode may cause current blocks to be lost. Do you want to continue?

editor.serial_detected: Currently, there is a serial connection to the Pico. Do you want to connect? If you want to try wireless connection, please select 'No'.
editor.wifi_detected_desc: Would you like to do wireless Pico connection now?
editor.wifi_conf_wrong:
1. WiFi is OFF.
2. Or, Not connected to WiFi starting with pico-(4digits)
3. Or, Wrong WiFi setting in Pico.

For reference, when connecting to a WiFi starting with pico-(4 digits), the connection password is pwd-(4 digits) of the name. Try connecting to the dedicated Pico WiFi mentioned in step 2. Or, do you reset the default wireless settings in Pico?
editor.wifi_different_device: Detected device ({new}) is different from the previously connected one ({old}). Connect anyway?
editor.noCodeToUpload: No code to upload. Please write some code first.
editor.noCodeToRun: No code to run. Please write some code first.
editor.serialNotSupported: This browser does not support Web Serial API. Please use Chrome or Edge.
editor.android_wifi_error_guide:
WiFi connection failed.
If basic wifi setting is not correct, connection will be failed.

Solution:
Run 'Basic Library Install & Wireless Setup' on PC to complete wifi setting, then retry.
editor.wifi_ssid_mismatch: Current Wi-Fi ({ssid}) does not start with 'pico-'. Attempt connection anyway?
